title: runs.jsonl line
description: One line of <project>/project-context/memory/runs.jsonl, appended by every agent at the end of every run, failures included. See shared/skills/keeping-project-memory/SKILL.md. Validate with: python3 shared/scripts/validate_json.py --jsonl shared/schemas/run-record.schema.json <runs.jsonl>

ts.description: Run end time, ISO 8601 with timezone.

agent.description: Agent folder name, for example carousel-builder.

label.description: The run's output label, for example the carousel topic slug.

status.description: partial: delivered with skipped capabilities or unresolved BLOCKs listed in the report; skipped: an idempotence guard found the output already present.

inputs_hash.description: sha256 (hex, any prefix of 8+ chars) of the resolved inputs, so a scheduled re-run can skip unchanged work.

outputs.description: Files written, relative to the project folder.

providers.description: Provider used per capability (see shared/tools.md), for example {"web_search": "builtin"}.

checks.description: Mechanical gates and their result, for example {"copy_lint": "pass", "brand_schema": "pass"}.

critic_verdict.description: Overall verdict of reviewing-with-fresh-eyes, none when it did not run.

human_verdict.description: What the founder said about the deliverable, none when they have not answered yet.

decisions_added.description: Ids of decisions.md entries added or replaced during this run.
